content: If a DemComponent is set to `not available' via Dem_SetCom- ponentAvailable and any individual event assigned to it (see [SWS_Dem_01227]) is already failed, the individual event will be kept as `available'. Dem_SetComponen- tAvailable still shall return E_OK.
